results.title: Ana kankankan tsakanin jam'iyyar Netanyahu da ta Eisenkot a zaɓen Isra'ila
results.content: Sakamakon farko-farko a zaɓen Isra’ila na nuna cewa ana kankankan tsakanin jam’iyyar Firaminista Benjamin Netanyahu da ta Gadi Eisenkot a wani yanayi da aka bar jam’iyyar Larabawa a baya, kodayake tana da rawar takawa wajen haɗa ƙawance duk da yake masana na ci gaba da tsokaci kan yiwuwar tasirin hakan.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Rahoto kan sakamakon binciken musabbabin mutuwar masu haƙar ma'adinai 33 a Neja
results.content: Kwamitin da gwamnatin tarayyar Najeriya ta kafa don bincika dalilan mutuwar mahaƙa zinari su 33 hannun jami’an tsaron Civil Defence a jihar Neja, ya tabbatar da cewa matasan sun mutu ne saboda zafi da kuma cunkoso a ɗakin da aka kulle su.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Tinubu ya yi umarni bincike kan kisan malamin addinin Islama sheikh Masussuka
results.content: Shugaban Najeriya Bola Ahmed Tinubu ya yi tir da kisan gillar da wasu ƴan bindiga suka yiwa Malamin Addini, Sheikh Yahaya Ibrahim Masussuka da abokinsa Adamu Abubakar a kofar gidansa da ke Dutsamma a jihar Katsina tare kuma da bada umarni ga rundunar ƴansanda da sauran hukumomin tsaro da a gaugauta gudanar da bincike kan kisan.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: Zaɓen Isra'ila: Netanyahu ya soki jam'iyyun Larabawa da maguɗin zaɓe
results.content: A Isra’ila, ana ci gaba da kaɗa ƙuri’u a zaɓen ‘yan majalisar dokoki, yayin da Firaminista Benjamin Netanyahu ke fuskantar ƙalubalen da ka iya shafar makomarsa ta siyasa. Rahotanni na cewa an samu cincirindo masu kaɗa ƙuri’u fiye da yadda aka gani a 2022, daidai lokacin da ake samun takaddama tsakanin jam’iyyun masu hamayya da juna.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Chadi ta yi watsi da zargin Nijar na cewa ta kai hari yankin Agadez
results.content: Chadi ta yi watsi da zargin da Nijar ta yi mata game da kai hari wani yanki na jihar Agadez ta hanyar amfani da jirgi marar matuƙi wanda ya kashe mutane 2 tare da jikkata wasu.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: Lokaci na zai zo da zan lashe kyautar Ballon d’Or - Lamine Yamal
results.content: Ɗan wasan gaba na ƙungiyar Barcelona Lamine Yamal, ya kawo ƙarshen shurunsa tun bayan bada kyautar Ballon d’Or ta shekarar bana da aka yi a birnin London, inda ya ce lokacinsa na nan zuwa da zai lashe kyautar.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Kwamitin bincike ya bada shawarar korar jami'an NCDC da biyan diyyar mutane 77
results.content: Kwamitin binciken da gwamnatin Najeriya ta kafa domin gano dalilan da suka yi sanadiyar mutuwar mahakan zinare 37 da suka mutu lokacin da hukumar NCDC ke riƙe da su a Minna ya ce rashin iska ya sanya matasan sumar da ta kaiga rasuwar su.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Yanzu lokaci ne da za'a sakawa Tinubu saboda abinda ya yiwa arewacin Najeriya
results.content: Ɗan majalisar wakilan Najeriya daga jihar Kano Abubakar Kabir Bichi ya ce yanzu lokaci ne da za'a sakawa shugaban ƙasa Bola Ahmed Tinubu saboda yadda ya taimakawa tsohon shugaban ƙasa Muhammadu Buhari samun mulki a shekarar 2015.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: Rikicin kabilanci ya hallaka mutane 72 a Sudan ta Kudu
results.content: Aƙalla mutane 72 aka kashe, wasu 38 kuma suka jikkata a wasu mabanbantan hare-haren da yan bindiga suka kai lardin arewacin Tonj dake jihar Warrap a ƙasar Sudan ta Kudu.

results.title: Mbappe da La Liga sun nemi gafarar China
results.content: Tauraron ƙwallon ƙafar Faransa Kylian Mbappe ya nemi gafarar ƙasar China saboda abinda suka kira wuce makaɗi da ruwa wajen shaguɓen da ya yi a kan Mao Zedong, tsohon shugaban China.

results.title: Hukumar WHO ta ce a yanzu babu mai ɗauke da cutar Ebola a Najeriya
results.content: Hukumar Lafiya ta duniya WHO ta ce a yanzu babu mai ɗauke da cutar Ebola a Najeriya, bayan ɗauke matar da aka gano tana ɗauke da cutar zuwa ƙasarta Switzerland tare da mijinta, kodayake akwai gomman waɗanda aka killace don tabbatar da basu ɗauke da cutar.

results.title: Najeriya ta yaba da yarjejeniyar tsaron Nijar da Algeria
results.content: Gwamnatin Najeriya ta bayyana farin cikin ta da yarjejeniyar tsaron da aka kulla tsakanin Jamhuriyar Nijar da Algeria wadda za ta bada damar girke sojojin Algeria a Nijar.

results.title: An fara kaɗa ƙuri'a a zaɓen Isra'ila da ake ganin zai iya kawo ƙarshen mulkin Netanyahu
results.content: A yau Talata ne al’ummar Isra’ila kaɗa ƙuri’ar da ka iya kawo ƙarshen gwamnatin Firaminista Benjamin Netanyahu, a wani yanayi da yake fuskantar tarin ƙalubale saboda yaƙin Gaza.

results.title: An fara tsagaita wuta tsakanin Rasha da Ukraine a garin Oleshky
results.content: Rasha da Ukraine sun fara tsagaita wuta a garin Oleshky da sanyin safiyar Talatar nan don ba da damar kai kayan agaji ga al'umma, sai dai ana cigaba da kai munanan hare-hare a sauran sassan kasar.

results.title: Ya dace sauye sauyen Najeriya su shafi jama'a kai tsaye - Amina Mohammed
results.content: Mataimakiyar Sakatare Janar na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya Amina Mohammed ta yaba da sabbin sauye sauyen da gwamnatin Bola Tinubu ke aiwatar wa, yayin da ta buƙaci ci gaba da aiwatar da su tare da neman ganin an inganta su ta yadda za su amfani jama'a

results.title: Amnesty ta yi Allah wadai da kisan Shiek Yahaya Masussuka da ƴanbindiga suka yi
results.content: Ƙungiyar Amnesty International ta yi Allah wadai da kisan shahararren malamin addinin Musulunci a Najeriya, Shiek Yahaya Masussuka.

results.title: Kotun Mali ta sami tsohon magajin garin Bamako da laifin sayar da filaye ba bisa ƙa’ida ba
results.content: Kotun musamman da ke hukunta masu yi wa arzikin ƙasa ta’annati a Mali, ta yanke hukuncin ɗaurin shekaru 10 gidan yari kan mutane 7 ciki har da tsohon magajin garin birnin Bamako Adama Sangare, bayan samun su da laifin sayar da filaye ba a kan ƙa’ida ba.
